observations: A solid black four-legged animal sits on a flat black shelf against a burnt-orange field; its outline is traced with a thin orange-gold edge line.
Two spiral-coiled yellow-green circles serve as eyes; two small white triangular points mark the mouth area below them.
Loose yellow zigzag and wavy lines radiate across the entire orange background, denser near the upper left and sparser toward the right edge.
reading: The black figure holds the center with a flat, cut-out weight, while the radiating yellow lines give the surrounding field a charged, almost vibrating quality. The spiral eyes read as wide alertness rather than calm, and the white points below them add a faintly unsettling edge. Orange and black together push the mood toward heat and tension rather than warmth.
